subject: Crestline go-live sequencing and SOW tasks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Crestline kickoff — SOW signed and next steps

Hi Mina / Irene —

Quick update from my side: Crestline signed the SOW last night (attached). They committed to a phased rollout across two regions (Mid-Atlantic then Midwest) and expect a pilot acceptance window of 6 weeks after env provision. Key commercial notes:

- Committed monthly reserved capacity (dedicated) + fallback to hosted for overflow.
- Start date for provisioning: target week of 2029-04-22.
- Post-sign checklist: security intake, KMS key exchange, and sequencing call.

External contacts: Lisa Grant (Director, Ops) and Tom Wheeler (Cloud Eng). Lisa asked that we outline the implementation milestones and owners by Friday.

I’m assigning Mina as primary CS owner to run the activation and Irene as tech lead for deployment validation. Priya, can you own training materials / onboarding sessions for end users?

Attachments: Crestline_SOW_signed_20290414.pdf (SOW), initial_deployment_matrix.xlsx (high-level timeline)

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@crestlinehealth.com>, Tom Wheeler <tom.wheeler@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Crestline kickoff — SOW signed and next steps

Thanks, Ben — great news. I’ll take point on the activation and outline a runbook for the pilot. Quick notes / asks from CS side:

1) Environment requirements: we need the VPC details and expected peak concurrent sessions for the pilot so we can size the Dedicated pool.
2) Security/compliance: Crestline indicated SOC2 report + KMS integration. Irene, please confirm what artifacts you need from their side to complete KMS onboarding.
3) Acceptance criteria: we should confirm the pilot success metrics (latency SLAs, SLO for inference accuracy on our smoke prompts, and throughput).

Action items I’ll take in the next 48 hours:
- Draft a 6-week activation timeline and owner map (will use Ben’s matrix as baseline).
- Schedule an initial sequencing call with Lisa/Tom for 2029-04-18 (propose 14:00 ET).
- Populate a deployment runbook stub and share for review.

Lisa / Tom — are you ok with 2029-04-18 at 14:00 ET for a 45-minute sequencing call?

Mina
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wheeler <tom.wheeler@crestlinehealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Crestline kickoff — SOW signed and next steps

Hi Mina — thanks and congrats on moving forward. 14:00 ET on 2029-04-18 works for me; Tom is in on that slot as well. A couple of clarifications for the call:

- We will need the Dedicated pool in us-east-1 for the pilot. Estimated peak concurrent sessions: 400.
- Security team will join the call briefly; they want to confirm data residency and KMS handshake process.
- We have one third-party ETL team that will need read-only access to logs; will need guidance on scoped roles.

Also attaching our internal onboarding questionnaire for your security review (I’ll paste the key items on the call too).

Thanks —
Lisa
Lisa Grant
Director, Operations
Crestline Health

Attachment: crestline_onboarding_questionnaire.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@crestlinehealth.com>, Tom Wheeler <tom.wheeler@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 16:48:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Crestline kickoff — SOW signed and next steps

Everyone — thanks for the quick confirmations. Short next steps summary (I’ll put this into the shared Doc after the call):

- Sequencing call: 2029-04-18 14:00 ET (45 mins) — agenda: provisioning timeline, KMS/key exchange, roles for log access, pilot acceptance metrics.
- Owners: Mina (CS lead / pilot acceptance owner), Irene (tech lead / KMS + infra validation), Priya (training + enablement), Ben (executive sponsor).
- Info required from Crestline before provisioning: VPC peering & subnets, expected FQDNs, list of ETL vendor IPs, and signed KMS key policy.
- Deliverables before provisioning: deployment matrix (attached), security intake completed, access plan for ETL vendor (role mapping).

Irene — can you confirm ETA to review Lisa’s questionnaire and whether you need anything else before Friday?

Mina
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
